verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.speechischeap.com/mcp over Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in and named tools and prompts, and a runtime probe confirms the endpoint is live and correctly OAuth-gated. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing a transcription through the MCP server, and the quoted tool list does not explicitly include the job-creation tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your AI client to the Speech is Cheap MCP server at: https://mcp.speechischeap.com/mcp
The server provides remote MCP connectivity over Streamable HTTP.
